topology: 3x Standard_D4as_v5 brokers (4 vCPU, 16 GiB) + 1x D2as_v5 control plane + 1x D4as_v5 load generator, proximity placement group, accelerated networking
release_brokers: v0.3.0 tarball (control plane runs a patched build with the alg-less-JWK + configurable-TTL fixes; off the data path)

icmp_rtt_ms.note: ping -qc10, ICMP is deprioritised on Azure and overstates

quic_path_rtt_us.note: from broker quinn ConnectionStats, the real transport RTT

path_mtu.note: settled path MTU on the VNet

premium_ssd_fsync_us.note: raw os.fsync() of a 256B write on /data, n=50

token_exchange_us.note: warm JWKS, CP-local (add ~260us for a remote client); RS256 verify + RBAC + EdDSA mint, n=200

idp: Microsoft Entra ID app registration, client-credentials grant, v1 token (iss=sts.windows.net), RS256

broker_cpu_during_ingest.note: CPU busy% (/proc/stat delta, mid-run) during ~980 MB/s 4KiB n=12 ingest to non-durable perf-ingest
broker_cpu_during_ingest.reading: loadgen-VM-limited at ~1 GB/s; brokers have headroom (42-73%), broker-0 hottest; true broker ceiling modestly higher, reachable with more loadgen VMs

oncommit_write_latency.note: durable cache put on on_commit brokers; concurrency 1 = one device flush per write (no group commit)
oncommit_write_latency.finding: durable stream append group-commits to >1 GB/s, but the durable cache-write path is fsync-serialized (~230 puts/s); concurrency adds latency, not throughput

delivery_latency_profiles.note: same non-durable pubsub, batch-1; the two profiles differ only in the broker's delivery-batch knobs
delivery_latency_profiles.finding: minimizing delivery batching cuts publish-to-subscriber latency ~30x (to ~=ack latency); the default trades it for delivery batching that helps sustained throughput

network_ceiling.note: iperf3 loadgen<->broker-0, VNet, accelerated networking; raw TCP, unencrypted
network_ceiling.comparison: Felix peak 4KiB ingest 1.09 GB/s (8.7 Gbit/s) = ~73% of raw TCP line rate, but encrypted (QUIC/TLS1.3), framed, durable-capable, and fanned across 12 shards / 3 brokers

multi_loadgen_ingest.note: two load generators (D4 + D2) driving ingest into the 12-shard non-durable perf-ingest stream simultaneously, 4KiB
multi_loadgen_ingest.finding: single-loadgen ~1.09 GB/s was loadgen-NIC-bound, not Felix; two loadgens sustain ~1.63 GB/s with linear addition (loadgen1 undegraded) and zero loss; brokers now the emerging constraint (broker-0 84%). True 3x4-vCPU broker ceiling ~1.6-1.9 GB/s.
